REVIEW FAIL (code): Invalid manifest repair guidance — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/commands/project-discover.ts:49-53
  EXPECTED: Report .gwrk/context-manifest.json as invalid and reserve the gwrk init recommendation for missing managed context. Discovery still exits zero.
  ACTUAL: The readiness?.context.status !== "ready" branch prints "Repair managed context with gwrk init." for a version 1 manifest without decisions. Running gwrk init --context-only --non-interactive with that manifest exits 1 at manifest.decisions[key] in src/application/architecture/install-context.ts:37.
  FIX: Suppress the init recommendation when the context manifest is invalid. Preserve the missing-context hint and pass the compiled discovery regression in the phase gate.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T007, gate: gates/phase-02.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

Leave the decisions index missing to exercise both issue kinds. Use `run()` to verify exit 0 and assert that `.gwrk/context-manifest.json: invalid` appears and `gwrk init` is absent. Run the existing `specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-02.sh` before and after the fix to verify the regression fails and then passes.
FIX: src/commands/project-discover.ts — Replace `readiness?.context.status !== "ready"` with a check for absent `readiness` or a `missing` context issue. Suppress the init hint if `readiness.context.issues` contains `{ path: ".gwrk/context-manifest.json", kind: "invalid" }`, even when other files are missing. Keep the existing issue rendering.
FIX: specs/045-workflow-governance/plan.md — Add the compiled invalid-manifest and suppressed init-hint assertions to TR-006. Retain the missing-context and exit-signal assertions.

  WHERE: src/commands/project-discover.ts:52-61
  EXPECTED: Discovery exits zero, reports the unreadable context manifest and missing decision index, and suppresses the init hint.
  ACTUAL: With a directory at .gwrk/context-manifest.json, the missing index satisfies the init-hint guard. gwrk init --context-only --non-interactive exits 1 with EISDIR on the manifest.
  FIX: Suppress the init hint for an unreadable context manifest as well as an invalid one. Preserve the hint for missing managed context with a readable or absent manifest. Pass the compiled regression in src/commands/project-discover.readiness.test.ts:115-122.
